description: Twin time stands still until you move it. Scheduled scenario events happen on the way, each at its own time, and the webhooks they cause are delivered to the subscribed URLs before this answers; 0 minutes only sends deliveries already due. Answers with the new twin time and how many scenario events happened.

minutes.description: Minutes of twin time to move forward, up to ten years

name: twin_advance_clock
title: Move twin time forward
